decision: accepted-debt; nonblocking conservative local availability false-negative
reason: D07/DOD04 require unavailable-after-error while preserving prior facts. Persisted producer CAS remains monotonic; delayed error performs no later backend write. Current safe error contains no committed failure fence/context. Consumer preserves latest status/time/fence/resource/content and withdraws local availability conservatively; subsequent explicit successful refresh recovers. Passive success is not contractually a completed newer explicit intent. No stale APPROVED promotion, tenant breakout or send is established. This is not permission to weaken mandatory server fences or current-failure handling.
exact_limit: Held completed failure2, canonical success3 by another authorized client, passive3 delivered, then failure2 delivered can show3 unavailable until explicit refresh. Both individual and catalogue directions source-supported, not executed; all797 does not prove that ordering.
tradeoff: Accept occasional extra operator refresh under the existing approved error semantics instead of adding unapproved error metadata/extra HTTP/new state owner. Stronger guarantees need truthful producer-owned committed failure authority with uncertainty semantics and boundary tests.
mandatory_current_fix: SEC-R35-01 and ADH-R35-01 current-selected retention remain blocking; no debt waiver for them. No migration/runtime/Meta admission.
preserved: All current common-negative, editor-proof, TTL, historical, current-failure and opposite-order tests; immutable ACK and existing read-budget debt unchanged. No repeated credential confirmation/retest.
